## Added

- Native **Linux arm64** support for both **core** and **aws**, alongside amd64. Each image tag selects the matching architecture automatically through an immutable OCI index.

## Changed

- Refresh the checksum-pinned Temurin 25 build image.
- Validate runtime behavior and Trivy policy separately on both architectures; retain index and child digests in the publication record.

Images: `quay.io/rambow-cloud/keycloak:26.8.1-r3-core` and `quay.io/rambow-cloud/keycloak:26.8.1-r3-aws`.

[Architecture guide](https://github.com/rambow-cloud/keycloak/blob/main/docs/architectures.md) · [Digests and pull commands](https://github.com/rambow-cloud/keycloak/blob/main/releases/README.md#v2681-r3) · [Security fixes by version](https://github.com/rambow-cloud/keycloak/blob/main/docs/security/README.md)
name: Keycloak 26.8.1 image revision 3: native arm64 support
